finding: Initial 180 degC illustrative critical limit coincided with fixed model nominal reference and produced false critical advisories. Corrected using the nominal model envelope, not held-out outcomes. Initial process-positive evaluator also mislabeled every process anomaly critical; corrected to compare private physical values with configured limits after predictions.
fault_scenarios: Existing 200 kPa anomaly stays noncritical. New explicit 500 kPa severe synthetic case crosses the pressure policy limit. No plant/sensor/detector algorithm changed.
